# Schools Week

> Schools Week is an independent education journalism outlet providing news, analysis, and expert commentary on UK school policy, funding, leadership, and reform.

Schools Week covers critical issues affecting the UK education sector including school funding, academies, Ofsted inspections, SEND reform, assessment policy, and education leadership. The publication offers both free news content and premium subscription access to in-depth journalism and podcasts.

## Key Topics

- Education policy
- School funding
- Ofsted inspections
- Academy trusts
- SEND reform
- GCSE and assessment
- School leadership
- Inclusion
- Curriculum review
- Educational technology
- Student mental health
- School attendance
- DfE policy
- Multi-academy trusts
- School accountability

## News and Coverage

- [All news](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/all-news): Comprehensive news roundup covering education policy and schools
- [School funding](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/school-funding): Coverage of school budgets, deficits, and financial management issues
- [Academies](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/academies): News and analysis on academy trusts, mergers, and MAT developments
- [Ofsted](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/ofsted): Ofsted inspection reports, framework changes, and school regulation news
- [Politics](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/politics): Education policy news, government announcements, and political commentary
- [Inclusion](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/inclusion): SEND reform, special schools, and inclusion policy coverage
- [Assessment](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/assessment): GCSE, BTEC, exams regulation, and assessment framework updates
- [Movers and Shakers](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/movers-and-shakers): Education sector leadership appointments and executive changes

## Opinion and Analysis

- [Opinion](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/opinion): Opinion pieces on education policy, leadership, and school reform
- [Opinion: Accountability](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-accountability): Opinion on Ofsted accountability, inspection frameworks, and school leadership
- [Opinion: Attendance](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-attendance): Opinion pieces on school attendance crisis and policy solutions
- [Opinion: Curriculum review](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-curriculum-review): Expert opinion on curriculum reform and subject education policy
- [Opinion: Edtech](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-edtech): Opinion on AI, cybersecurity, and educational technology in schools
- [Opinion: Mental health](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-mental-health): Opinion on student and teacher wellbeing and mental health support
- [Opinion: SEND](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/opinion-send): Expert opinion on SEND policy, inclusion, and special education reform
- [Letters to the editor](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/theme/letters-to-the-editor): Reader responses and letters on education policy and school issues

## Podcasts and Subscriptions

- [The Schools Week Podcast](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/the-schools-week-podcast): Weekly podcast featuring education leaders discussing policy reform
- [Subscribe to Schools Week](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/subscribe-to-schools-week): Subscription plans for Schools Week journalism and podcast access

## Contributor Guidelines

- [How to write for Schools Week](https://schoolsweek.co.uk/opinion/how-to-write-for-schools-week): Contributor guidelines and submission process for opinion pieces
